text:
Seedance 2.0

Then I added the storyboard as a reference in Seedance 2.0 and adapted the following prompt

Prompt:

[CINEMATIC SETUP] Full-color 3D animated comedy short, cinematic cartoon style, bright sunny park, polished lighting, expressive faces, vibrant colors. Keep left-right continuity: the squirrel always runs from screen left to right straight toward the raccoon and donut box. The raccoon stays by the bench.

Prompt:

[CHARACTERS] Chubby donut-loving raccoon with striped tail. Small hyperactive squirrel with fluffy tail.

[TIMELINE]

0–1.5s: [Wide / Static] Raccoon finds a donut box on a park bench.
1.5–3s: [Medium / Push-In] Raccoon opens the box in awe.
3–4.5s: [MCU / Pan] Raccoon hears rustling from screen left and looks that way.
4.5–6s: [Wide / Tracking] Squirrel sprints from screen left toward the bench and donut box.
6–7.5s: [Medium / Push-In] Raccoon protects the donut box.
7.5–9s: [Close / Forward] Squirrel crashes into raccoon, donuts fly.
9–11s: [Close / Tight] Both scramble for falling donuts.
11–13s: [Medium / Static] Both freeze, each holding half a donut.
13–15s: [Wide / Final Hold] They glare, then bite at the same time.

[STYLE & QUALITY] Sunny park, green grass, grey-brown raccoon, orange-brown squirrel, pink icing, smooth comedic timing.
content: [CINEMATIC SETUP] Full-color 3D animated comedy short, cinematic cartoon style, bright sunny park, polished lighting, expressive faces, vibrant colors. Keep left-right continuity: the squirrel always runs from screen left to right straight toward the raccoon and donut box. The raccoon stays by the bench.

translations.es:
---
[CINEMATIC SETUP] Cortometraje de comedia animado en 3D a todo color, estilo de caricatura cinematográfica, parque soleado y brillante, iluminación pulida, caras expresivas, colores vibrantes. Mantener la continuidad izquierda-derecha: la ardilla siempre corre de izquierda a derecha en la pantalla directamente hacia el mapache y la caja de donuts. El mapache permanece junto al banco.
---
translations.fr:
---
[CONFIGURATION CINÉMATIQUE] Court-métrage comique animé en 3D en couleur, style cartoon cinématographique, parc ensoleillé et lumineux, éclairage soigné, visages expressifs, couleurs vives. Maintenir la continuité gauche-droite : l'écureuil court toujours de l'écran gauche vers la droite directement vers le raton laveur et la boîte de donuts. Le raton laveur reste près du banc.
---
translations.ja:
---
[CINEMATIC SETUP] フルカラーの3Dアニメーションコメディショート、シネマティックなカートゥーンスタイル、明るい日差しの公園、洗練されたライティング、表情豊かな顔、鮮やかな色彩。左右の連続性を維持：リスは常に画面の左から右へ、アライグマとドーナツの箱に向かってまっすぐ走る。アライグマはベンチのそばに留まる。
---
translations.ko:
---
[CINEMATIC SETUP] 풀컬러 3D 애니메이션 코미디 단편, 시네마틱 만화 스타일, 밝고 화창한 공원, 세련된 조명, 표현력 있는 얼굴, 생생한 색상. 좌우 연속성을 유지하세요: 다람쥐는 항상 화면 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 너구리와 도넛 상자를 향해 곧장 달립니다. 너구리는 벤치 옆에 머물러 있습니다.
---
translations.pt-BR:
---
[CONFIGURAÇÃO CINEMATOGRÁFICA] Curta de comédia animado em 3D e em cores, estilo de desenho animado cinematográfico, parque ensolarado e brilhante, iluminação polida, expressões faciais expressivas, cores vibrantes. Mantenha a continuidade esquerda-direita: o esquilo sempre corre da esquerda para a direita da tela diretamente em direção ao guaxinim e à caixa de donuts. O guaxinim permanece ao lado do banco.
---
translations.zh-CN:
---
[CINEMATIC SETUP] 全彩3D动画喜剧短片，电影卡通风格，明亮的阳光公园，精致的灯光，富有表现力的面部表情，鲜艳的色彩。保持左右连续性：松鼠始终从屏幕左侧向右侧直奔浣熊和甜甜圈盒子。浣熊留在长椅旁。
